strategyReview: Broad live edges remain the weekend Hyperliquid funding reversion (70% win on 431 live trades) and the gated one-touch NO edge on upside barriers, while PC_RATIO extremes are only modestly positive and FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG is still bleeding in spots. The major losers are spot-directional shadows that fade rich Polymarket barrier/tail premiums into trending commodity moves, cross-asset momentum confirmation at local highs, and standalone funding-threshold reversions. Keep capital toward structural weekend funding normalization and selective one-touch premium fade with informed-flow confirmation, not PM-richness as a stand-alone spot signal.

failureClusters.theme: Rich PM barrier/tail fade against underlying trend
failureClusters.evidence: gold one-touch heatmap 0/20, no-bias gold rich tail 0/17, OIL find_0024 5/19, and gold PM premium mean-reversion 2/17 all tried to short spot/one-touch premium while GOLD/OIL kept rising or chopped through richness.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not trade PM richness as spot directional. Kill or disable these directions; at most keep upside-barrier YES fade when confirmed by smart-flow selling and non-trending conditions.

failureClusters.theme: Cross-asset momentum confirmation at local highs
failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 6/22; BTC near 7-day high plus HYPE above 24h SMA repeatedly produced -2.9% to -3.5% BTC moves instead of +2% continuation.
failureClusters.recommendation: Invert or retire the confirmation thesis. If HYPE risk participation is already strong near BTC highs, treat it as crowded-long risk and require funding exhaustion or clear break of trend before fading.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-539 fired on standalone CBRS funding below -10 and produced 11/23 wins. The losing examples show funding moving 5.5% to -13.7%, or only small positive moves, not the expected weekend normalization; the threshold is too low to separate genuine weekend overshoots from ordinary noise.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The cross-asset momentum confirmation variant repeatedly went long BTC near its 7-day high when HYPE was above its 24h SMA, but BTC fell -2.93% and -3.47% in multiple tests. HYPE participation was a crowded trend marker rather than a continuation edge.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI confirms a >2% BTC long move over 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 0/20 gold one-touch heatmap tests won. Instead of declining after a large underlying-cap edge, GOLD rose 5.37% and 3.97% in representative tests, showing the richness reflected real bullish touch demand and spot momentum.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The no-bias adjusted gap gold short-rich-tail variant went 0/17, with GOLD moving essentially flat to higher after the gap condition. The no-bias gap stayed pinned while spot trended against the short.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: find_0024 scored only 5/19 and burned tests on spot proxies. OIL rose 4.30% through the supposed overpriced premium window, indicating that rich PM IV near expiry was marking a real directional move, not dumb YES demand.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Rich PM IV on near-expiry OIL above-strike one-touch YES implies premium decay within 3 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The gold PM premium/futures spread mean-reversion setup is 2/17 in contaminated retest, with hard-coded 4800 PM settlement levels and GLD P/C below 0.65 not forecasting a spot rally; spot instead fell slightly or stayed below PM levels.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Gold P/C ratio collapse below 0.65 with PM settlement EV above 4800 predicts spot rally toward PM levels within 7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight focused on killing false PM-rich spot-directional assumptions and requiring explicit confirmation. Structural weekend funding normalization and gated above-strike one-touch NO fade remain the strongest forward edges. Several spot shadows using PM cap/no-bias gaps or PM-IV richness were invalidated because the premium stayed rich while the underlying trend dominated. Refinements were added to require true weekend funding reversion, smart-flow confirmation, and crowded-long funding exhaustion rather than standalone bounce conditions.
